note: Units that read `sub` off the verified token and never resolve the caller: routes and services from 2026-09-04, MCP surfaces from 2026-09-06, and all of src/ less tests, generated, static and data from 2026-10-18 (the thirteen units in src/auth and src/middleware that joined that day were read one by one; none hands an identity to storage). A listed unit that no longer exists fails the gate from the same day.Triaged 2026-09-04, the day the gate was written, in groups: the units ARE grouped, since twelve dispute audit entries are one line with twelve event names. Every group's pattern was read in the source first, and the generator refused to write a file with any unit outside a named group. Two verdicts appear. The ones that hand the value to a call carry the reason that call needs it — an ACTOR in an audit trail or on a schedule, the caller's OWN GAII on an agent-only door. A third reason stood here until 2026-09-12 and is gone: twenty-two entries in six files said `sub` was the FALLBACK argument resolveGhii took, one sentence copied over and over, and every new route asking which human it acted for produced the next copy. The helper no longer takes a fallback identity from its caller — it composes the GHII from the node — so nineteen of those units stopped reading `sub` at all and left this file, and the three that remain were reading it for something else the copied sentence had hidden: the principal recorded on a schedule a package install or migration writes. A sentence repeated seven times is a sentence nobody reads. The rest say NOT HANDED TO A CALL, which is a mechanical fact rather than a judgement: a comparison, a log line or a presence test cannot file data under the wrong identity. One door found by this gate was fixed instead of listed: GET /v1/apps/:owner/:filename answered 402 PURCHASE_REQUIRED to the buyer, the buyer's agent AND the seller, because it asked for a licence under `sub` while every receipt is keyed on the owner coordinate (utils/gaii.ts ownerCoordinate, and test/e2e-app-store-license.ts now covers the download). A unit leaves this file by being fixed or by someone deciding its reason is wrong — not by re-seeding, which would forgive the lot.
